particle_and_boids.resource: final SSBO reused as vertex buffer

particle_and_boids.sync: GL_BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT; blocking map, no unsynchronized mapping

framebuffer_passes: Draw to one texture then sample it from a different FBO in the same context. No attachment is sampled while it is the current draw attachment. Ordinary FBO ordering is not replaced with unnecessary compute memory barriers.
workgroup_note: Each invocation owns one destination element and only reads the previous ping-pong source. No same-dispatch cross-invocation communication is used; no workgroup barrier is needed.
